authenticated_capture.principle: Only exact, complete, non-quarantined capture can enter the audit.

coverage_vs_global_reset.principle: Lower error cannot come from excessive new abstention.

coverage_vs_local_reset.principle: Lower error cannot come from excessive new abstention.

e2e_pipeline.principle: Authentication, replay, controls, reduction, and classification must complete.

equal_labels_and_memory_cap.principle: Arm comparisons require equal scoring labels, schedules, and memory limits.

false_accept_vs_global_reset.principle: Lower error cannot come from more unsafe accept decisions.

false_accept_vs_local_reset.principle: Lower error cannot come from more unsafe accept decisions.

full_cold_replay.principle: Audit completeness requires every prediction and arm transition.

future_error_vs_global_reset.principle: Released labels must improve later full-denominator error over both reset controls.

future_error_vs_local_reset.principle: Released labels must improve later full-denominator error over both reset controls.

hostile_controls.principle: Each hostile copy must have its declared independent outcome.

immutable_source_rows.principle: Development interventions cannot modify real producer evidence.

independent_intervals.principle: Whole streams and each stratum remain separate independent units.

legitimate_later_changed_predictions.principle: Only changed predictions after release count as learning progress.

non_feedback_error_vs_global_reset.principle: Released labels must improve later full-denominator error over both reset controls.

non_feedback_error_vs_local_reset.principle: Released labels must improve later full-denominator error over both reset controls.

recurrence_error_vs_frozen.principle: A pooled result cannot hide harm after either form of recurrence.

time_and_byte_violations.principle: A favorable result cannot exceed the frozen time or state bounds.

causal_intervention_rows.expected: erasure produces a measured later prediction and outcome contrast

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Actual current executable model identities; historical identities remain in sidecars.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Every check has expected, observed, passed, and a one-line principle explaining its purpose.
field_principles.causal_intervention_rows: Past-prediction invariance and retained-evidence interventions expose leakage and inert memory.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: Record the actual UTC terminal decision time.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_task: The audit traces the actual across-query learning mechanism.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure total elapsed and disjoint phase spans including failed work.
field_principles.execution_venue: Record actual host/device work; a CPU replay is not GPU or FPGA execution.
field_principles.experiment_id: Bind the evidence to the active experiment task.
field_principles.factor_audit_complete_score: One for complete cold replay, independent of efficacy.
field_principles.factor_promotion_score: Independent future-prediction evidence controls any promotion.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked result names upstream, check, exact field, observed value, and expected value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_ or complete:; external failure starts blocked_. State the finding.
field_principles.independent_stream_intervals: Preserve exact paired denominators and every stratum.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe actual computation with a recognized literal, not intended work.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Full generation has a 60s floor; bounded generation 10s; load-only 2s. Never pad time.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted, completed, failed, cancelled, and in-flight loads and generations.
field_principles.model_invoked: True for any attempted model load or generation, even when output is unusable.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Hash real inputs and record actual availability and failed checks.
field_principles.random_seed: Seal development and independent evaluation seeds before seeing outcomes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, inputs, config, model when used, and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Record every comparative unit and arm with metrics, costs, errors, abstentions, and censoring.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260914 with actual UTC start/end and monotonic phase timing.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Keep planned, attempted, complete, and censored counts with the frozen stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the record while keeping ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate producer identity, terminal class, and quarantine state.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record the actual UTC start of this audit.
field_principles.status: Write the terminal result only after the work and checks; checkpoints remain separate.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Record exact commands, scope, exit codes, elapsed time, and log hashes; retain failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Exactly positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only unfinished own work is partial; unchanged external failure is blocked.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Shared evaluator authority permits circular_positive only, not positive scientific value.

checks.principle: Implementation starts only after its requirement exists.
Each required behavior needs one named scenario.
Run only the active task and its declared output.
Only complete prospective capture can authorize the audit.
Incomplete external work cannot authorize the audit.
A numeric score cannot override quarantine.
A numeric score cannot override disqualification.
Retired producer evidence cannot authorize promotion.
Producer headline fields cannot replace internal row and checksum validation.
All 107,520 immutable prediction rows must be present.
All 3,072 releases and 15,360 arm transitions must be present.
The producer restart and rollback sidecar must retain exact bytes.
Replay uses the exact stream and executable bytes measured by the producer.
An excluded task identifier must stop before audit work.
Only task-owned result, raw, and checkpoint paths can receive writes.
Every source and evidence identity must be hashable before replay.
